versions.changelog:
k12-teacher 0.1.2 adds project governance and contribution support.

- Added GitHub issue and pull request templates, CODEOWNERS, funding information, and Dependabot configuration.
- Added CI workflow and repository structure validation updates.
- Added governance and support documentation, plus Git attributes.
- Removed skill-card.md; updated repository documentation and metadata.

- Removed the file skill-card.md from the project.
- No changes were made to core functionality or documentation aside from this file removal.

- Initial release of the k12-teacher skill.
- Provides a five-tier instructional expertise framework modeled on professional teacher certification.
- Supports all core K-12 subjects for Primary, Junior Secondary, and Senior Secondary grades, organized by syllabus and grade.
- Outlines a mandatory five-phase instructional workflow: Diagnose, Select, Deliver, Assess, and Remediate.
- Includes boundary conditions defining appropriate and inappropriate usage, with clear escalation triggers.
